verdict.rationale: HubSpot's Workflows tool supports building automated, recurring processes (e.g., time-based enrollment triggers) and sequences enable timed follow-ups, plus an MCP server gives AI agents CRM read/write access — but there's no evidence of AI-native scheduling of recurring jobs/workflows via API or agent-driven cron-like automation. The capability exists mainly through the traditional workflow builder UI, not an AI-native interface for defining/scheduling recurring automations.
